content.text:
So, in case you're wondering how it went: I got two rough numbers, but I'm not confident in them. The page shows "נשאר בידיים", what's left in your hands: about **60,600 ₪ after 4 years** and about **133,400 ₪ after 8 years**. I'd want to check both with you or the bank before doing anything.

**Why I'm not sure:**
- **The self-employed button didn't work.** The calculator is set up for employees ("שכירים"). I pressed "עצמאים" three times and nothing changed.
- **So I faked it.** I set the employer's part to 0 and my own part to 10% of the 12,000 that was already there. That's 1,200 ₪ a month from me.
- **What I put in:** 57,600 ₪ by year 4, 115,200 ₪ by year 8.
- **The growth is assumed, not promised.** The numbers count on "תשואה בשנה 7" (a 7% return every year), and the page says the money is "במסלול מדד". To me מדד is the price index on the news. I don't know what it means here, or whether it can fall like that fund did.

**What I read, in order:**
1. **The top of the page.** You can take the money out tax-free after 6 years. For self-employed people the tax break covers up to 20,566 ₪ a year.
2. **The calculator.** I changed the two percentage boxes, then pressed 4 and 8 under the little bar chart.
3. **I stopped there.** I didn't read the rest of the long page.

**What bothered me:**
- **The red minus numbers under "המס לקח".** −2,347 ₪ at 4 years, which I understand, since that's before the 6 years. But at 8 years it still shows −4,209 ₪, even though the top of the page says "פטור ממס" (tax-free). The chart just says "פטור עד התקרה", tax-free up to a ceiling. I don't know what ceiling, since my 14,400 a year is under the 20,566.
- **The dark screen.** The grey writing under the chart ("גררו את הסמן…") was hard to read.
- **Colours I couldn't tell apart.** The two greens and the pink stripes in the bars.
- **The first example scared me.** Before I changed anything it showed an employer adding 54,000 and tax taking 13,974. It took a while to see that wasn't about me at all.

input.answer: Paying 1,200 ₪ a month myself, the page shows about 60,600 ₪ in hand after 4 years (57,600 put in) and about 133,400 ₪ after 8 years (115,200 put in). These are rough: the self-employed button didn't work, so I set the employer's part to 0 and my own part to 10%, and the growth assumes 7% a year.

stuck.why: Pressed 'עצמאים' three times (by its words and by position) and it stayed on 'שכירים'. I had to work around it by setting the employer's share to 0.
There is no box for a monthly amount for self-employed, only a percentage of a salary, so I had to guess a percentage (10% of 12,000).
The top of the page says tax-free after 6 years, but at 8 years it still shows −4,209 under 'המס לקח', with only 'פטור עד התקרה' as explanation.
